description: This file defines API interaction functions for a frontend application, including HTTP methods (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), handling authentication headers, error processing, and specific API endpoints for work items and comments in a bug/issue tracking context.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (no authorization required) based on its starting segment.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers, adding an Authorization header if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles HTTP error responses, throwing errors, and performing auto-logout on 401 for protected routes.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend, returning parsed JSON or null.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item using GET.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item with author info sourced from localStorage or provided explicitly.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, setting creator info from local storage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for an API endpoint based on current base URL.
